hypothesis: Postgres WAL retention deleted the segments before Debezium read them, so the re-pricing changes never left the source; raise max_slot_wal_keep_size.

verdict.reason: The hypothesis blames Postgres WAL retention and the replication slot, which puts both the failure and the cause in the postgres layer. The ground truth is Kafka topic retention deleting change records before order-sync read them, so the hypothesis gives the wrong layer and the wrong mechanism.
